note: RedBrick Health (employee health engagement, Minneapolis) raised $45M from Highland, Versant, Fidelity and KPCB (Wikipedia). It merged into Virgin Pulse (announced May 2018, Twin Cities Business; closing reported January 2019; Google News check 2026-09-30), so acquired. The firm's listing starts in 2009; the band's 2010 Form D ($152,800, Beth Seidenberg) is not an entry round, and the entry is not named on record.

Solexel (thin crystalline silicon solar cells, Milpitas) renamed itself BeamReach Solar in 2016; in May 2017 advisors were hired to sell BeamReach's assets (Renewables Now; Google News check 2026-09-30). No completed sale to a successor is on record, so defunct.

Spatial Photonics (projection microdisplays, Sunnyvale) was backed while Vinod Khosla was at the firm (to 2004), long before the band's 2009 Form D; the round is not on record. The firm's own archived page reads Acquired in 2012, 2013 and 2014 without naming the buyer; Google News (2026-09-30) shows only a 2013 Himax story. Khosla's row reads defunct.
